title: The room was very clean and well organised. Alona and Julie were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the virtual check-
positive_text:
We had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel!

The room was very clean, well organised and comfortable, and everything was exactly as we expected. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout our stay, and the access system with the entry code was very simple, convenient and made everything feel easy and secure.

A special thank you to Alona and Julie, who were absolutely amazing and so friendly! Even though the reception process was virtual when we arrived, they assisted us through the computer with the check-in and made the whole experience incredibly smooth. Everything was explained clearly, communication was excellent, and the process was quick and straightforward with no unnecessary complications or bureaucracy. We really appreciated how helpful, patient and welcoming they were.

The location is also very convenient. It’s easy to get around using public transport, and being close to Allianz stadium and Bondi Beach is definitely a big plus, especially if you want to explore one of Sydney’s most popular areas.

Overall, we really enjoyed the practicality of the hotel, the cleanliness, the location and especially the excellent customer service. Everything worked perfectly from check-in to check-out.

Thank you again to Alona and Julie for making our stay even better. We would happily stay here again!

title: I’d definitely consider staying here again, even for leisure. Highly recommend!
positive_text:
I stayed at Potts Point for just one night as part of a longer business trip across Australia, and I was genuinely impressed by how comfortable and convenient the experience was.

The location is truly ideal—quiet and charming, yet still close to the action. It's just a short walk to the Town Hall station, which made getting around the city incredibly easy. I even managed to squeeze in a quick visit to Bondi Beach, which was only a few rides away—perfect for unwinding after a full day of meetings.

The hostel itself is well-designed and thoughtfully maintained. The backyard and dining area stood out to me as peaceful spots where you could relax, grab a cup of coffee, or get some work done if needed. It was clear that the staff take pride in keeping the place clean and organized—my private room was spotless, and the shared areas were tidy and welcoming.

Special mention goes to the receptionist, who was not only polite and professional but also very efficient. After a long day of travel and work, I appreciated how quick and smooth the check-in process was. They also gave great recommendations for nearby places to eat and how to get around easily.

All in all, Potts Point Hostel exceeded my expectations, especially for a short business stop. It’s a great blend of comfort, cleanliness, and location, with a touch of character that makes you feel more at home than in a typical hotel.

The kitchen is full of fruit flies, the bathrooms are constantly wet, (but pressure and water temperature are good) kitchenware is poorly washed and the place is older and beaten up compared to what is shown on booking. Only 1 bathroom per floor in my building and some nights I had to go in the building next door (part of the hostel) to use the toilet. At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on.
There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen.

If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.

I messaged asking for someone to come and clean the room again but much to my confusion the staff member just took the toothpicks then left, I had to end up changing the bed sheets myself and explaining he needed to get a cloth to wipe down the shelf which was very dirty and remove the fingernails. Would also say there could be more consideration around times to hoover, we were woken up early in the morning by someone hoovering right outside our door which wasn’t ideal with jet lag. I’d also say the pictures of the room definitely don’t match the room, there’s a lot of wear and tear which isn’t in the picture, and again very unclean. Also the aircon is so loud so you may struggle to sleep with it on but then the room is very stuffy and hot without it.

title: Quantité n'est pas égal à qualité...
positive_text: J'imagine que pour des personnes en working holiday c'est un bon moyen d'économiser de l'argent. Mais en tant que voyageurs il y a des hostels beaucoup mieux pour le même prix ou moins cher.
negative_text:
Pas de réception sur place, tout se fait par WhatsApp et les seules personnes qui travaillent sont celles qui viennent pour nettoyer mais elles sont en général pas au courant de chose lier au fonctionnement de l'hôtel.
Donc si vous chercher des bons conseils pour visiter Sydney c'est clairement pas ici que vous les aurez.

Avant même d'arriver j'ai senti le genre d'hôstel: après avoir lu de nombreux commentaires négatifs, j'ai souhaité annuler ma réservation. Comme cela n'est pas proposé dans leurs options quand on réserve, booking a fait une demande à l'hôstel, leur laissant donc le choix d'accéder à ma demande, mais ils ont refusé me disant que c'était le fonctionnement de booking (alors que booking leur laisser le choix). En gros ce qui compte c'est leur argent, pas la satisfaction client.

Ensuite, le jour de mon arrivée, je n'ai pas pu manger le soir car je n'avais pas réservé pour le repas, sachant que la réservation doit se faire avant 16h, que l'on découvre ça une fois que l'on a fait le check in, donc pour ceux qui font un check in après 16h ne comptez pas sur un repas le premier soir.

Les petits déjeuners sont basiques: pain blanc, peanut butter, confiture et café soluble.

Les espaces communs ne sont pas très agréables et donc pas propices pour rencontrer du monde. La terrasse qui avait l'air très chouette sur les photos est en pente et donne sur une palissade en bois (donc oublié la jolie vue derrière). Et vous y rencontrerez de nombreux cafards.

Les lits sont corrects mais il n'y a pas de quoi ouvrir les fenêtres et il fait donc très chaud dans les chambres. Et les clims sont supers bruyantes. Donc au choix: on meurt de chaud où on dort dans le bruit.

Au passage, le dortoir 6 places pour femme dans lequel j'étais est en sous sol avec une grande fenêtre donnant sur la rue, sans rideau, d'où n'importe qui peut donc nous voir.

title: Nice hostel, but poor food, and no on-site staff.
positive_text:
Positives :
- 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station
- cooking facilities available.
- laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
negative_text:
Negatives :
- no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance
- dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken.
- Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight.
- The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make.
- there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times.

Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.
